name: OXR
cost: Free API for testing. The model is under the OXR Open Source License, based on Apache 2.0 with extra terms
works_with: SoMark's somark-py and somark-js tools, or its own local API
short: An open document parsing model that turns PDFs and scans into Markdown or JSON with layout coordinates.
what: OXR is a 1.3B parameter model from the SoMark team that reads PDFs and document images and outputs Markdown or JSON, with bounding boxes. It recognises 13 element types, including tables, formulas, chemical equations and structures, and code blocks. The team says it ranks first on olmOCR-Bench, OmniDocBench and DocParsingBench, and its layout analysis model can be swapped for your own.
who: Developers building document pipelines or feeding PDFs to AI agents. Running it locally needs a large NVIDIA GPU, so most people should start with the free API.
needs: For the free API: Python or Node.js to install the somark CLI
To run it locally: Linux, an NVIDIA GPU with BF16 support and at least 24 GB of memory (48 GB recommended), a CUDA 13.0 compatible driver, and Python 3.12

steps.title: Try the free API
steps.text: No sign-up or key is needed. Install one of the CLIs and point it at the free API.
steps.code:
# using python
pip install somark
# or using js
npm install -g somark-js

somark --base-url https://free-oxr.somark.ai/api/v1 --api-key dummy \
  parse document.pdf --formats md,json --out ./parsed-output/

steps.title: Download the code and model
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SoMarkAI/OXR.git
cd OXR

# pip install -U huggingface_hub
hf download SoMarkAI/OXR-1.0 --local-dir ./models/OXR-1.0

steps.title: Run it locally with Docker
steps.text: When the logs say the services are ready, open http://localhost:8000/demo. The first start can take a while.
steps.code:
docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.allinone -t oxr-1.0 .
docker run --rm --gpus all --ipc=host \
  -p 127.0.0.1:8000:8000 \
  -v "$PWD/models/OXR-1.0:/models/oxr-model:ro" \
  oxr-1.0

try.label: From the README
try.text: Upload one of your own PDFs to the online demo and compare the Markdown and JSON output.

watch: The free API sends your documents to SoMark's servers. The team does not recommend it for production, does not guarantee stability, and says it stays online only while they can afford to run it.
The license is custom, based on Apache 2.0 with additional terms. Read it before commercial use.
